svg.title: Two controller source paths, not one universal delay
svg.desc: Ordinary execution needs a scheduled ready operation and the executor gate. Whitelisted execution uses a separate role and allowed target/function pair without the ordinary scheduling wait. Current roles, whitelist and minimum delay remain unverified at the common observation block.

g.text: Two execution paths in the controller source
Executor role, or an open executor gate
The ordinary delay applies to this path.
Target contract + function must be allowed
Whitelist does not fix the input values
No ordinary scheduling wait on this path.
Both paths still face the destination contract’s own checks.
Unknown at the common block: current roles, whitelist, minimum delay and full controller links.
This is a source map—not evidence that a specific harmful action can bypass a delay today.
